name: Devin
description: Harness local do Devin via ACP, com ferramentas Buzz e revisão manual de permissões.

args: latest=$(find "$HOME/.codex/sessions" -type f -name 'rollout-*.jsonl' -printf '%T@ %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort -rn | head -n 1) && f=${latest#* } && [ -f "$f" ] && echo "${latest%% *}" && grep rate_limits "$f" | tail -n 1
